text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Deputy minister of oil says Iraq's oil pipeline network is ready to transport any increase on oil exports.
- A U.N. team starts visit to Saddam river to check its effect in fighting desertification in southern Iraq.
- Iraq's deputy foreign minister holds talks in Moscow to enhance cooperation between Iraq and Russia.
- Jordan's industry and trade minister says in Amman his talks in Baghdad were fruitful.
- More foreign companies are submitting offers in order to conclude trade deals with Iraq.
(The above stories were also carried by IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)

- Head of the French-Iraqi friendship society Gilles Monnier criticises France's refusal to treat President Saddam Hussein's eldest son Uday on its territory. Uday was wounded in an assassination attempt in Baghdad last month.
